name: Los Altos Hills Youth Commission
what_you_do: Give Los Altos Hills teens a voice in town government. Members help organize and volunteer at town events and run at least one youth project each year.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students who live in Los Altos Hills. Up to 20 members.
duration: One-year term. Members can be reappointed for up to 7 terms.
deadline_text: The page gives no application dates. The town's August 26, 2026 openings list does not include the Youth Commission. In 2026, the Town Council appointed five new members on June 18.
how_to_apply: Fill out the town's form for joining a group. You fill out a form and talk with the Youth Commission and staff. Then the Town Council talks with you and votes to add you.
notes: Meets at 7 p.m. on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of each month. Members lose their seat after missing 3 meetings in a row or going below 75% attendance in a year. The June 2026 council recap says candidates must first attend at least one meeting and volunteer at town events. After that meeting there were 17 members, so a few seats may be open.
